the social supply chain risk and its consequences for the supply chain, which are not sufficiently studied in literature.

social supply chain risk is a complex phenomenon that is still little studied and that it is necessary to continue researching in this field to improve the knowledge of the topic.

social supply chain risk is a complex issue that needs to be addressed by managers and researchers.
